# Historical Named Version fixture

`named-version-v5-61a4659.json.gz.b64` is a synthetic compatibility fixture
generated by the OpenFilm application at commit
`61a46596d7a2cd17e1c993b2b6fd3f31c5ed807d` (catalog schema v5).

The decoded JSON envelope is 462,222 bytes with SHA-256
`8596f6d84d71a69ff7f79e41c01be8c897df6e94972e7940af3bd8d643863730`.
It contains the exact `project.json`, live `database.sqlite`,
`versions/index.json`, and three immutable package files emitted by
`ProjectVersionService.create`. The package ID is
`5115ec4b-3e72-4320-a99b-aed08929ee9e`.

The project and catalog contain only generated identifiers, the synthetic URI
`file:///synthetic/legacy.png`, and an unreferenced synthetic image record. No
media, credentials, workstation paths, or personal information are included.
The test validates the envelope hash and exact file set before materializing it
in a private temporary directory.

Generation used the historical application API to create a project, add the
synthetic catalog record, save it, and create one named version. The
application was closed before reading the six files. The JSON envelope stores
each file as base64 and is gzip-compressed at level 9 before base64 encoding.
